M_check: S-4 self-text analysis: count of 'binding' vs 'non-binding' vs 'letter of intent' / LOI mentions in reservation/order context
M_value: S-4 self-text: 2 'binding' mentions, 7 'non-binding' mentions, 8 'letter of intent / LOI' mentions in reservation/order context. The 'binding' mentions include the qualifier that Nikola BELIEVES reservations WILL BE CONVERTED to binding — i.e., they are not binding at the time of filing.
interpretation: Self-contradiction: the same S-4 that markets the order book to investors discloses internally that the orders are non-binding.
